title: Base-changed edge maps carry the unit of a composite to the pullback
statement:
Let $f:Y\to X$, $\pi:Y'\to Y$ and $i:Z\to X$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $f'=f\circ\pi$, and $G$ an abelian sheaf on $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Put $Y_Z=Y\times_XZ$ and $Y'_Z=Y'\times_XZ$ [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $i_Y:Y_Z\to Y$, $f_Z:Y_Z\to Z$, $i_{Y'}:Y'_Z\to Y'$, $f'_Z:Y'_Z\to Z$, and let $\pi_Z=\pi\times_X\mathrm{id}_Z:Y'_Z\to Y_Z$, so that $i_Y\pi_Z=\pi i_{Y'}$ and $f_Z\pi_Z=f'_Z$; regard the two squares $(f,f_Z,i,i_Y)$ and $(f',f'_Z,i,i_{Y'})$ as cartesian squares [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with $\theta$ built from the composition isomorphisms as in [lem-weil-pbc-edge-map-base-change]. For a cartesian square $\square=(h,h',i,i')$ with $h:W\to X$ and an abelian sheaf $E$ on $W_{\Et}$ write
$$\Phi^q_{\square,E}=e^q_{h',i'^{-1}E}\circ H^q(\Ex^0_{\square,E}):H^q(Z_{\Et},i^{-1}h_*E)\to H^q((W\times_XZ)_{\Et},i'^{-1}E),$$
with $\Ex^0$ the underived exchange morphism [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange] and $e^q$ the edge map of [lem-weil-pbc-edge-map-base-change] (pullback map [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] followed by $H^q$ of the counit). Let $u:f_*G\to f'_*\pi^{-1}G$ be $f_*(\eta_{\pi,G}):f_*G\to f_*\pi_*\pi^{-1}G$ followed by the identification $f_*\pi_*=(f\pi)_*$ of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] ($\eta_\pi$ the unit of $\pi^{-1}\dashv\pi_*$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]), and let $\kappa:\pi_Z^{-1}i_Y^{-1}G\xrightarrow{\sim}i_{Y'}^{-1}\pi^{-1}G$ be the composition isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] for $i_Y\pi_Z=\pi i_{Y'}$. Then for every $q\ge0$
$$\Phi^q_{(f',f'_Z,i,i_{Y'}),\pi^{-1}G}\circ H^q(i^{-1}u)=H^q(\kappa)\circ\pi_Z^*\circ\Phi^q_{(f,f_Z,i,i_Y),G}:\ H^q(Z_{\Et},i^{-1}f_*G)\to H^q((Y'_Z)_{\Et},i_{Y'}^{-1}\pi^{-1}G),$$
$H^q(\varphi)$ denoting the map induced by a morphism of sheaves [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial]. No finiteness is needed; the case $Z=X$, $i=\mathrm{id}$ is allowed. (Intended proof: [lem-weil-pbc-edge-map-base-change] for both squares reduces the claim to the case $i=\mathrm{id}$, where it follows from clauses 3 (naturality) and 4 (composition) of [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial] and the triangle identity $\varepsilon_{f'}\circ f'^{-1}(u)=\pi^{-1}(\varepsilon_f)$ composed with the identifications, up to the composition isomorphisms.)
